matchingRules: providerResults.providerKey must match the passed liveProviderEvidence providerKey
signalResults must include exactly every required signal for the provider
environmentId, imageDigest and sampledAt must match the liveProviderEvidence entry
artifact JSON must not include tokens, credential values, private network URLs or raw provider payloads

signals.requiredSignal: live Hacker News HTTP listing and search return normalized stable ids
rate-limit budget and degradation behavior are recorded for deployed Hacker News scans

liveProviderEvidence.exitCondition: Attach live HTTP smoke and rate-limit evidence for Hacker News before external beta.

signals.requiredSignal: representative allowlisted live RSS feeds return normalized items
ETag and Last-Modified cache behavior is recorded for repeated live feed scans
SSRF protections reject private, loopback, file and metadata-service targets before fetch

liveProviderEvidence.exitCondition: Attach allowlisted feed, HTTP cache and SSRF evidence for RSS before external beta.

signals.requiredSignal: live GitHub API smoke returns normalized issue items with canonical GitHub URLs
GitHub rate-limit budget and fallback behavior are recorded for deployed scans

liveProviderEvidence.exitCondition: Attach live API smoke and rate-limit budget evidence for GitHub before external beta.

signals.requiredSignal: tenant-owned Reddit OAuth credential returns normalized listing items
invalid or expired Reddit OAuth credential fails closed with classified auth failure
Reddit rate-limit budget and retry/degradation behavior are recorded
credential create, rotate, revoke and redacted preview lifecycle is recorded without exposing tokens

liveProviderEvidence.exitCondition: Attach tenant OAuth, auth failure, rate-limit and credential lifecycle evidence for Reddit before external beta.

deferredProviders.exitCondition: Authorized channel scope and credential lifecycle must be approved before enabling Telegram automation.
Paid API or approved vendor contract must be approved before enabling X/Twitter automation.

externalBetaExitCriteria: HN, RSS, GitHub and Reddit live evidence artifacts are attached for the promoted backend image.
RSS SSRF proof and HTTP cache evidence are attached before any external beta feed binding is enabled.
Reddit tenant OAuth lifecycle evidence proves create, rotate, revoke and redacted preview behavior.
Telegram and X/Twitter remain deferred and cannot appear in enabled beta provider bindings.
